fix: `build(self)` owns `decoration` and each of these style fields is read exactly once, so drop the clone: `Text::new(label).style(decoration.label_style.unwrap_or_default())`, and likewise `decoration.prefix_style.unwrap_or_default()`, `decoration.suffix_style.unwrap_or_default()`, `decoration.counter_style.unwrap_or_default()`. Line 899 already does this for error_style, so the code is inconsistent.

`raw_magnifier(&self)` clones the shadows Vec and allocates a new Rc on every call. If the magnifier is consumed when a RawMagnifier is built, take it by value: `pub fn raw_magnifier(self) -> RawMagnifier` and use `shadows: self.shadows,`. Callers that still need the Magnifier clone it explicitly. If the borrowing signature must stay, cache the Rc shape or document the per-call allocation.
